description: Built-in sensitivity labels: an ordered taxonomy that classifications map to, so policies can be written on a few labels instead of every classification. A field's effective label is the one declared for it (by its source or by a person), else the highest-ranked label its classifications map to, else the default. See docs/sensitivity.md.

labels.name: Public
labels.description: Approved for anyone, inside or outside the organisation.

labels.name: Internal
labels.description: For people in the organisation; little harm if it leaks. The default for data nothing marks as sensitive.

labels.name: Confidential
labels.description: Personal or business data that would harm people or the organisation if it leaked: names, contact details, dates of birth, addresses.

labels.name: Restricted
labels.description: The most sensitive data: government ids, payment and bank details, health data, secrets and credentials.
